purpose: Final-prediction logical consistency only (is_incident vs event_type). Not a calibration layer: no threshold, probability, category answer, risk, confidence, human_review, priority, attention order or same_incident value is changed.
incident_threshold_source: identical to P1-v1/P2-v1 adapter.is_incident_threshold (experiments/p1_decisions/configs/decisions_questions_v1.json); shared by every model

rules.when: p_incident is a number and p_incident < 0.5
p_incident >= 0.5 and raw category is one of the incident-like categories
p_incident >= 0.5 and raw category is no_clear_incident
rules.reason: R2 would otherwise produce the reverse contradiction (is_incident=true, event_type='no clear incident'); mapped to the existing taxonomy value 'uncertain'

rules.when: p_incident >= 0.5 and raw category answer unavailable (refused/invalid)

rules.reason: the frozen v1 adapters already set is_incident=false when p_incident is unavailable; the event_type states the decision is unknown instead of showing a category as if an incident were decided

event_type_map.possible_scene_or_boundary_entry: possible scene or boundary entry (boundary semantics unknown)

event_type_map_source: copied verbatim from P1-v1 decisions_questions_v1.json adapter.event_type_map (checked by scripts/validate_normalized.py)
